# Nitemare3D Win16 1.10 — pass117, 2026-10-30

## Finding
Confirmed by original instructions: E516 normalizes with at most one add360 and one subtract360, computes direction indices/mask, samples literal sine/cosine tables and derives movement error terms. Entire routine and table helpers execute without stubs for inputs-360..719. All65536WORDinputs are checked only through the prefix before table lookups. Preserved Ghidra12.2 exports, no fresh Ghidra or live Win16/game execution.

## Evidence

|---|---|---|---|---|
|Confirmed|Signed negative adds360 once; signed>=360 subtracts360 once. Not general modulo.|E51B–E539|High|AllWORDinputs execute prefix with independent16-bit signed oracle.|
|Confirmed|Index4BEC=trunc(angle/45); mask4BF0=(WORD(1<<(index&31)))&99; rounded index4BEE from doubledWORDangle/45 and lowAL increment/mask.|E53C–E564|High|AllWORDprefix cases including overflow/negative values.|
|Confirmed|Valid normalized angles use originalECAC/ECF8 and separate91WORDquartertables.|E567–E582;ECAC/ECF8;DS025E/0314|High|1080full cases, literal table oracle; no ideal floating trig substituted.|
|Confirmed|With S=abs(sin),C=abs(cos),m=min,M=max:4C06=(S>C),4C08=2m-M,4C0A=2m,4C0C=2(m-M).|E585–E5D0|High in valid domain|Full output comparisons after original helpers.|

## Behavior model
Normalize once, derive orientation selectors, then load sine-like and cosine-like values. Full valid input range-360..719 produces final0..359. Inputs outside this range may remain invalid; the routine does not iterate until in range. Retain separate literal tables: cosine quarter60=511 differs from reversed sine quarter30=512 as noted by prior static evidence. Derived error terms are initialized from the selected table values; later movement may mutate them separately.

## Verification
**65,536 prefix cases plus1,080 full cases**. Prefix stops at E567 before pushing heading to sine helper; it checks heading4BEA, index4BEC, rounded index4BEE and mask4BF0, without executing potentially invalid table accesses. Full cases run input-360..719 through originalE516→ECAC/ECF8 to far return; compare signed table outputs and all four derived terms. Stack and BP/SI/DI restoration checked on full returns.

No API/callee stubs. NE3 atCS3000; internal CALL selectorsE56E/E57D normalized3000. OriginalNE10 data image loadedDS1048, including literal tables; SS1048,D000stack. Signed quotient truncation andWORDoverflow explicitly modeled for prefix. Data copied from EXE, not recomputed from mathematical sine. No collision/movement/rendering or timing test.

EXE SHA256 `12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481`; NE3 file15FC0,NE10 file2C040. Sources:verify_heading_state.py,verification.json,native_evidence.json,baseline48/pass48-results/listing.tsv.

## Implementation-ready findings
Preserve one-step correction rather than general modulo if matching arbitrary input behavior. Within proven valid range, use literal91sample tables and exact index arithmetic. Store derived error-state seeds exactly; reconstructing them lazily after later mutation could change behavior. Previous joystick translator116 passes raw heading target to E516; this pass verifies its normalizer separately, not an integrated collision/gameplay chain.

## Unknowns and next test
Integrate96F6 with actualE516 for valid heading and positive speed parameters, keeping movement calls stubbed. Follow8AAC and8604 to see how error state4C08 is consumed/mutated. Out-of-domaintable behavior and callers constraining angle input remain distinct questions.

## Confidence
High for allWORDprefix and stated full-domain output; no complete gameplay parity claim.
